sources.title: Faster R-CNN: Towards Real-Time Object Detection with Region Proposal Networks
sources.titleEn: Faster R-CNN: Towards Real-Time Object Detection with Region Proposal Networks
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: YOLO：網格輸出與偵測張量
related.titleEn: YOLO: grid predictions and detection tensors
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付錨框索引、IoU測試及形狀覆蓋表。；3600及2400可核對，IoU基本案例正確且窄框召回差異有證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver anchor indices, IoU tests and shape-coverage tables.; Counts and basic IoUs match, with evidence for narrow-box recall differences.
related.difference: 展開一格13個值，區分兩框10值及共享3類別值；畫物件中心的責任格。；637與2548一致，展平往返完全相同且座標誤差小於1e−6。
related.differenceEn: Expand13 values per cell: ten box values and three shared classes; mark the responsible cell by object center.; Counts match, tensor roundtrip is exact and coordinate error is below1e−6.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每位置a個錨框，候選數HWa；這是篩選前數量，不等於最終偵測數。；教學H=W=20，3尺度×3比例=9錨框；改3尺度×2比例。；N=20×20×9=3600；6錨框時2400。
初代網格輸出元素S²(B×5+C)，每框4座標加信心；此公式不通用於後續所有版本。；教學S7,B2,C3；比較S14，類別數為合成設定。；E=7²(2×5+3)=637；S14時2548。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With a anchors per position, proposals number HWa before filtering, not final detections.; Teaching20×20 map with3 scales×3 ratios=9 anchors; compare3×2.; N=20×20×9=3600; six anchors give2400.

Original output size is S²(5B+C), with four coordinates and confidence per box; later versions differ.; Teaching S7,B2,C3, compared with S14; class count is synthetic.; E=7²(2×5+3)=637; S14 gives2548.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ViT：影像Patch與序列長度
related.titleEn: ViT: image patches and sequence length
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付錨框索引、IoU測試及形狀覆蓋表。；3600及2400可核對，IoU基本案例正確且窄框召回差異有證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver anchor indices, IoU tests and shape-coverage tables.; Counts and basic IoUs match, with evidence for narrow-box recall differences.
related.difference: 為14×14patch給列優先編號，再加分類token0；標位置編碼與patch線性投影shape。；197與50正確，patch展平往返無遺漏，分類token位置明確。
related.differenceEn: Number14×14 patches row-major, prepend class token0 and label positional and projection shapes.; Counts197 and50 match, patch roundtrip is lossless and class-token position is explicit.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每位置a個錨框，候選數HWa；這是篩選前數量，不等於最終偵測數。；教學H=W=20，3尺度×3比例=9錨框；改3尺度×2比例。；N=20×20×9=3600；6錨框時2400。
N=(H/P)(W/P)+1含分類token；非整除尺寸須另定padding或裁切。；教學224×224，P16；比較P32。；N=14²+1=197；P32時7²+1=50。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With a anchors per position, proposals number HWa before filtering, not final detections.; Teaching20×20 map with3 scales×3 ratios=9 anchors; compare3×2.; N=20×20×9=3600; six anchors give2400.
N=(H/P)(W/P)+1 includes a class token; nondivisible sizes need explicit padding or cropping.; Teaching224×224 image, P16 versus P32.; N=14²+1=197; P32 gives7²+1=50.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
